findings.evidence: Quotient.lean:83 `def stableInnerDerivation (z : A) : stableDerivations R I`; Basic.lean:191 `def innerDerivation : A →ₗ⁅R⁆ derivationLieAlgebra R A`; grep `def codRestrict` in Mathlib/Algebra/Lie hits only `LieModuleHom.codRestrict` (Submodule.lean:922).
findings.fix: Define `stableInnerDerivation : A →ₗ⁅R⁆ stableDerivations R I` (fields are `Subtype.ext` of `innerDerivation`'s, as in Basic.lean:193-197) and state the compatibility lemma as a `LieHom` equality, keeping the pointwise version as its `congrFun`.
findings.issue: `stableInnerDerivation` is a bare function `A → stableDerivations R I`, while both its source `innerDerivation` (Basic.lean:191, `A →ₗ⁅R⁆ derivationLieAlgebra R A`) and its consumer `derivationQuotientHom` are `LieHom`s; the hom-level compatibility `derivationQuotientHom.comp stableInnerDerivation = innerDerivation.comp mk` cannot be stated, so an inner-derivation action cannot be descended as a Lie-algebra action without re-proving additivity/bracket. Mathlib has no `LieHom.codRestrict` into a `LieSubalgebra` (only `rangeRestrict`, Subalgebra.lean:303) to recover it.

findings.fix: State the `@[simp]` lemma as `(stableInnerDerivation R I z : derivationLieAlgebra R A) = innerDerivation R z := (rfl)`; drop the double-coe form (simp derives it via `coe_innerDerivation`).
findings.issue: `coe_stableInnerDerivation` is stated at the double-coercion level `((… : derivationLieAlgebra R A) : Module.End R A)`; simp will not rewrite the single coercion `(stableInnerDerivation R I z : derivationLieAlgebra R A)` that appears after `mem_stableDerivations` or in subtype goals, even though it is `rfl` and the double-coe form follows from it plus `coe_innerDerivation`.

findings.evidence: Quotient.lean:179-183 has no attribute; `derivationQuotientHom_apply_mk` (line 164) and `coe_stableInnerDerivation` (line 88) are `@[simp]`.
findings.issue: `derivationQuotientHom_stableInnerDerivation` is the normal-form rewrite `descent (inner z) = inner (mk z)` but carries no `@[simp]`, so simp leaves `derivationQuotientHom R I (stableInnerDerivation R I z)` unreduced while every other characteristic lemma here is simp.

summary: Descent surface is minimal and well-characterized (`_apply_mk` simp, `_comp_mkQ`, hidden body, old module path fully removed). The inner-derivation side is under-bundled and under-annotated relative to the LieHom API it sits between.
